# Sharjeel Hashmat — Compass Key

> Sharjeel Hashmat is a Real Estate Consultant operating across the UAE, working with Royals Field Properties. Compass Key is his personal brand for market analysis, investor guidance and property consultation across Dubai and the wider UAE.
